Sarah L: Quick pulse: kernel + KV warmup milestone — canary results landed in staging. Can we get a quick status on blockers and PRs? Who owns the EU canary follow-up? cc @Olivia C @Rajeev
Rajeev: I reviewed the canary perf run. p99 fell ~12% on short sequences but throughput dropped ~6% on >1k tokens. Suspect prefetch ordering change. I'm bisecting.
Olivia C: I'm owner for eu canary follow-up. Plan: run extended 8-hour soak tonight, capture KV cache hit rates, and rerun with old prefetch toggle. Putting up PR for rollback knob.
Mike: FYI I saw a regen on the LRU eviction test. Added logs here: `logs/evict_2026-03-17.log`. Will attach snippet later.
Rajeev: Sharing quick command to run soak locally: ```./scripts/canary_run.sh --region eu-west-1 --duration 8h --seq-dist long```
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary build r-2026-03-17-89 deployed to eu-west-1 (canary). Link: https://deploys/internal/rs-2026-03-17-89
Sarah L: :thumbsup: Thanks. Olivia, can you confirm which test points you'll capture? need p95/p99/latency and kv hit rate per shard.
Olivia C: Yep. Will collect: p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, KV hit ratio, cache size, eviction rate. Adding trace id header for end-to-end latency.
Mike: Added integration test PR: `#4321` — small change to incremental prefetch ordering to prefer hot keys first. Needs review from Rajeev.
Rajeev: On it, will review by EOD. If it looks safe, we can try canary with `--prefetch-strategy=hot-first`.
Sarah L: If EOD review + soak show no regression, target rollout to staging->prod canary tomorrow morning. Any blockers?
Olivia C: One open: observed mem spike on shard 3 during warmup. Created issue #4976 with heap dump. Will investigate before prod.
Rajeev: Quick note: if mem spike can't be resolved, fallback plan is to enable `--prefetch=off` for long sequences and keep hot-first for short seqs. That should keep latency wins.
Sarah L: OK. Action items: Olivia -> soak + metrics + issue triage. Rajeev -> finish PR review and bisect. Mike -> attach eviction logs and link PR. I'll coordinate rollout timeline. Thanks all.
